name: Shrimp Squat
steps: Stand tall on one foot, bend your opposite knee behind you, and hold your lifted foot with the same-side hand behind your glute.
Reach your free arm straight forward for counterbalance and brace your core.
Bend your standing knee and hinge slightly forward to lower smoothly until your rear knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive firmly through your standing foot to return upright, and switch legs after completing one side.
tips: Tap your back knee gently to the floor rather than dropping your weight onto it or bouncing upward.
Keep your standing knee tracking straight over your toes and your heel grounded throughout.
